description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for managing remote clusters and shared channel remotes in the Mattermost admin console, including fetching, editing, and location utilities.

methods.name: useRemoteClusters
methods.description: React hook to fetch and manage list of remote clusters.

methods.name: useRemoteClusterEdit
methods.description: React hook to edit or create a remote cluster, managing state and save operations.

methods.name: useSharedChannelRemotes
methods.description: React hook to fetch shared channel remotes for a given remote ID.

methods.name: useSharedChannelRemoteRows
methods.description: React hook to get formatted shared channel remote rows with filtering options.

methods.name: useTeamOptions
methods.description: React hook to get active team options from Redux store.

methods.name: getEditLocation
methods.description: Generates location descriptor for editing a remote cluster.

methods.name: getCreateLocation
methods.description: Generates location descriptor for creating a new remote cluster.

methods.name: isConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if a remote cluster's site URL is confirmed (not pending).

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a remote cluster is connected based on last ping time.

methods.name: isPendingState
methods.description: Determines if a loading state is pending.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a loading state is an error.

methods.name: loadingStatus
methods.description: Utility to extract loading and error states from a loading state.
